$comment: What agents lack (docs/designs/fleet-telemetry.md#10-agent-gaps): the rules that give a failed agent tool call, gateway call or settings-only dispatch skip (source dispatch: the skip reason, tool the cause kind) its gap class. The coordinator applies them at ingest (go/coordinator/agent_gaps.go). Rules run in order; the first whose source, tools and match all hold wins. match is a Go regular expression over the failure text (agent: the tool's output or error; gateway: the call's errorCode); class may use {1}.. (match groups), {tool} and {connection}. class skip records nothing (the failure is counted elsewhere or is no gap). shell false limits a rule to tools that are no shell (shellTools), so text a command prints cannot pass for a tool's refusal. A shell command, or a harness lifecycle failure (turn.failed, result, unparsed), that matches no rule is no gap (its exit status is the program's answer; a run's failure has its own cause); any other unmatched failure is other, with its decisive line. families name the setting that controls each class and its label ({arg}: the part of the class after the family): the place a fix for every future agent goes. Changing this file reclassifies the retained window at the next coordinator start.

setting.text: Pin the command as a host tool (tool_pins), or install it in the host image (deploy/).

missing-module.label: {arg} package missing
missing-module.title: Language package missing on the host

setting.text: Pin the package with its runtime as a host tool, or install it in the host image (deploy/).
Add the path to the executor's writable roots, or point the tool's cache inside the working area.
Allow System V/POSIX shared memory in the sandbox profile, or run the server outside the sandbox.
Grant the profile network (gitNetwork) or reach the service through a Fleet connection.
Allow the API in code mode, or use the matching Fleet tool.

approval-denied.label: Command waited for approval
approval-denied.title: Command needed an approval nobody gave

setting.text: Run the harness unattended (no approval prompts) or allow the command in its profile.
Add the tool to the profile's tools, or tell the agent in its instructions which tool to use instead.
Pin Playwright and Chromium on the host and check the project browser server.

auth-unready.label: Command-line login missing
auth-unready.title: Login missing for a command-line tool

setting.text: Give the run a forge login through its project's connection instead of a host login.

model-unsupported.label: Model not offered to the account
model-unsupported.title: Model not available to the account

setting.text: Pick a model the run's account offers, or route the profile to an account that has it.
Make the tool's description name the rule it enforced, or change the agent's instructions.
Find why the coordinator did not confirm the call in time (telemetry_trace of the execution).
Grant the tool on the connection (connections_set_tools), or remove it from the profile.

gateway-unknown-tool.label: Gateway does not know the tool
gateway-unknown-tool.title: Gateway does not know the tool

setting.text: Add the tool to the connection's grants or to the provider catalogue.
Add keys to the connection's pool or raise the plan; check the key policy's failover codes.
Make the catalogue tool's schema and description match what the provider accepts.
Check the provider's status; consider a timeout or another provider for the tool.

placement-blocked.label: {arg} blocks placement
placement-blocked.title: No host can take queued work

setting.ref: hosts_update, project execution, harness placement (System › Hosts)
setting.text: Change the host or project setting the skip names (dispatch.go rankCandidates) so a host can take the work.
Add a rule that names the class and its setting.

finding.$comment: A class (not other) with at least minCount failures in at least minExecutions agent runs over the last days opens a finding (problem gap:<class>). After its pull request's release runs on every host, the finding compares the class's failures per agent run over watchDays before and after; at most fixedRatio of the before rate is fixed.
